messages.subject: How to improve processing time
parts:
Hi, I've created a new page called 'Improving processing time':

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/improving-processing-time

It show some tricks you can use to speed up the processing and things
to avoid which otherwise will kill your speed.

For users of Affymetrix most recent SNP & CN arrays (GenomeWideSNP_5 &
GenomeWideSNP_6), I've got good news. In the most recent version of
the package, I've added a way such that the PLM can be fitted to all
single-probe CN units more or less instantaneously, which will speed
up the process if not 50% definitely substantially. See above page
for more details.

Cheers

/Henrik
